source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Legends rules are official for games at home, in shops, at clubs and during campaigns. Check with the event organiser before bringing Legends to a competitive Warhammer event. Legends points get fewer updates than codex points. Retired units with a standalone or shared Legends datasheet use Legends points. The Munitorum Field Manual supplies those points. Follow the standard codex procedure to add these units to your army. For a Legendary Proxy, use the indicated codex datasheet and its Field Manual points. The proxy guidance also covers Legends units that share a datasheet. Tell your opponent which units the proxies represent during mission setup. If model dimensions or base sizes affect a ruling, such as visibility, give your opponent the benefit of the doubt.

standaloneOrSharedLegendsDatasheets.points: Legends entry in Munitorum Field Manual

legendaryProxyModels.points: points for that datasheet in Munitorum Field Manual
